_comment: Repos discovery must never propose, keyed by normalized owner/repo (lowercase). Authoritative across all three nightly phases. Keep this list short and reasoned: it is the kill switch, not a taste filter — routine 'not for us' calls belong in the review queue, which records who decided and when. The language entries below are belt-and-braces: the quality gate now hard-fails a repo whose sampled SKILL.md files are not in English, so discovery should never re-propose these on its own.

deny.reason: Competing product, not a skill library. A Tauri desktop app that syncs skills to 32 agent runtimes via symlinks — the same job as our desktop + sync. It also carries zero SKILL.md files, so there is nothing to mirror even setting the overlap aside; discovery only ever reached it because it matched a skills topic.
Non-English catalog policy: repo description is English but all 81 skills are Chinese.
Same author, same shape: Chinese skills behind an English description.
